svg.title: Classroom Widgets · iPhone timer
svg.desc: Eight screens: ready, running, countdown-only Focus, paused, finished, duration editor, end-at-time editor, and sound settings.
svg.text: The familiar rainbow timer, with a countdown-only view when controls aren’t in use.
Set a duration or start the default minute.
Extend or pause without leaving the timer.
After 5 seconds idle. Tap to show controls.
Resume, edit remaining time or restart.
Time’s up. Restart returns to Ready.
Set a duration without starting the timer.
See when the clock time next occurs.
Choose a sound or mute it for quiet work.
390 × 844 pt reference · not a simulator capture
